biological_replicate: HEK293T cells transfected with plasmids expressing either N- or C-terminally FLAG-tagged M protein (M-NF or M-CF, respectively)
experimental_design: Comparison of host proteins co-immunoprecipitated with N-terminally (M-NF) and C-terminally (M-CF) FLAG-tagged M protein versus control

We performed FLAG tag–based immunoprecipitation of lysates of HEK293T cells transfected with plasmids expressing either N- or C-terminally FLAG-tagged M protein (M-NF or M-CF, respectively) and identified host proteins that interacted with the M proteins by using mass spectrometry (MS)
factor_value: M protein tag position (M-NF, M-CF, control)
